title: Stimulus-family response prediction for calibrated Neuropixels units
disposition_reason: An exposure-aware adapter, train-only controls and genuine held-out spike scorer exist. Complete authenticated native export, permitted stimulus content, competent stimulus-transfer reference and participant execution remain missing, so the old not_implemented wording is superseded only for this construction component.

scientific_target.question: Can a response model calibrated on allowed stimulus families predict spike counts for withheld families in the same recorded units beyond train-rate and past-state controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Protected integer spike count over each eligible presentation after invalid neural intervals are removed; exposure is the remaining valid duration.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Selected Allen Visual Coding Neuropixels spike times and complete stimulus table; native NWB identity and export correctness remain unverified by the JSON adapter.
scientific_target.case_unit: Exact session/unit/presentation keyed observation with positive valid exposure.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; units, presentations and repeated stimuli are nested dependent observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Same-unit, within-mouse stimulus-family transfer. Predicting a held-out measured neural response is a legitimate neural target, although a programme score does not establish direct visual interpretation.
exclusions: Native NWB authenticity established by matching declared hashes

evidence.supports: Exact prior registered definition and unresolved source audit boundaries preserved before this revision.
Pinned-export preparation, exposure-aware counts, train-only controls, exact-key admission and mouse-macro bits/spike.
Explicit native-export/authenticity limitations and half-open window/invalid-interval policies.
Existing immutable AllenSDK source mappings and distinction between source inspection and installed native compatibility.

evidence.locator: Primary author abstract or official AllenSDK documentation, inspected 2026-11-16; narrower implementation details are supported by local source receipts.
evidence.supports: Official source describes Neuropixels spike-sorted NWB, stimulus and state metadata, quality limitations and incompatible old NWB versions; optical measurements are a separate modality.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human result for this task is established by the reviewed source. Source construction and generated engineering checks do not establish authentic performance.
excluded_claims: Native NWB authenticity established by matching declared hashes

summary: Recognized working construction scorer rather than stale not_implemented label.
Made valid exposure, undefined outcomes and same-unit family transfer explicit; identified absent stimulus content and competent reference.
revision.source_review: Inspected historical registration and actual task-local preparation/scorer/protocol source. Primary dataset identities checked against author abstracts or official AllenSDK documentation. No authentic recordings, held labels, fitting or model campaign in this revision.

inputs: Training rows with integer counts and valid exposure; query rows omit counts and include session/unit/presentation key, mouse, family, condition ID and time.
Allowed numeric/null stimulus attributes:orientation, contrast, spatial_frequency, temporal_frequency, phase, frame, color; no image/movie pixels are delivered.
Pre-onset running and pupil summaries plus coverage; no future-state interpolation.
forbidden_inputs: Query spike counts, raw source bundle, whole-session firing rates and precomputed tuning/state tables.
Future pupil or incomplete running intervals extending beyond onset.
Target-dependent unit/presentation exclusion or omitted held-family repeats.
observation_contract.case_identity: Every public/prediction row has exact[session_id, unit_id, presentation_id]. A frozen protocol supplies complete mouse/session/unit/presentation roster and table digest; no authentic current case roster is established.
observation_contract.split: All presentations of each frozen heldout family are query within each calibrated unit; other-family calibration rows within the symmetric temporal guard are purged. Conditions cannot cross families or splits. Same units must retain training exposure and every held family.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete selected export roster is required. Zero-exposure presentations are audited; selected units lacking calibration or held-family support cause failure. Actual complete native roster/presentation coverage is not proved by self-declared JSON.

primary.name: Mouse-macro held-out Poisson bits per spike relative to train-rate control
primary.aggregation: Sum y*(log(r)-log(r0))-exposure*(r-r0) and target spikes within each mouse; divide by spikes*log(2), then weight mice equally.
primary.rationale: Scores rates against genuine held-out count data with correct exposure and avoids neuron/trial pseudoreplication.

secondary: Same metric separately for each held stimulus family.
Comparison with train-only running/pupil shrinkage-cell control.
Complete exclusion, missing-state, zero-rate and zero-spike dispositions; proposed calibration diagnostics would be additional metrics.

comparators.name: Train-only mean rate
comparators.inputs: Training counts and valid exposure for each session/unit.
comparators.procedure: Implemented rate=total calibration spikes/total calibration exposure; whole-session SDK firing_rate is forbidden.

comparators.name: Train-only running/pupil control
comparators.inputs: Training state summaries and counts, query pre-onset state.
comparators.procedure: Implemented train median low/high/missing state cells; cell rate shrunk toward train mean by frozen positive prior seconds; unseen cells fall back to mean.

comparators.name: Stimulus-transfer reference
comparators.inputs: Same permitted training families, query stimulus representation and state.
comparators.procedure: A competent signal-derived response model must be selected and frozen on permitted development data. No qualified such reference is delivered; nuisance controls alone cannot establish stimulus-transfer competence.

nuisance_controls: Union-subtract invalid neural intervals from both spikes and exposure with half-open counts; invalid-stimulus closed-overlap invalidates whole presentation.
Freeze full repeat/condition roster and stimulus-family guards before outcomes.
Explicit past-state coverage and missing eye data without dropping affected observations.
Audit retrospective sorting/QC and complete native stimulus representation; no calcium substitution.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented 95% percentile bootstrap resamples complete mouse scores only when at least 2 mice and a finite estimand exist; 1000 draws and recorded seed by default. It does not make the selected mice representative or certify transfer.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every exact query key once with finite nonnegative rate. Zero held-out spikes or zero train rate with positive target leave the full macro endpoint undefined; zero candidate rate with positive target yields explicit negative_infinity. No epsilon or silent mouse dropping.

implementation.scorer_target: Genuine protected neural count prediction, not source-paper table reconstruction. A separate trusted native adapter must establish those counts are authentic.
implementation.delivered_scope: Standard-library JSON-export preparation, controls and scorer with generated engineering controls. It neither reads NWB nor authenticates declared recording bytes.
missing: Exact native cohort/clock/QC/invalid-interval/pupil mapping and complete source byte verification.
Stimulus content sufficient for the selected family transfer and a competent frozen reference.
Protected candidate execution and genuine complete-cohort controls.
implementation.execution_evidence: Documented generated checks exercise exposure, keys, guards, missing state and CLI; no authentic cohort/reference execution is established.

direct_observation.representation: Direct quantitative prediction could use calibration counts and allowed stimulus/state tables; a screenshot of spikes would reveal the target and changes the encoding task.
direct_observation.boundary: Any future no-tools condition must expose only the allowed observation and a fixed calibration context; participant code, source lookup and evaluator feedback are excluded.
missing: No bounded direct-response representation, participant transport or complete response collection is delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: A task-specific rendered observation with typed navigation would be a separate access condition, not evidence supplied by the programme.
typed_viewer.boundary: No current image-only action API; future views must preserve eligible channels/time/support without returning raw arrays or answer-bearing metadata.
missing: No typed viewer or viewer-model evaluation for this task.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical analysis could fit/calibrate on public training rows and predict query rates.
tool_assisted.boundary: Public/private files are an interface, not a sandbox; query counts/source bundle must remain unavailable and any model tools must be matched.
missing: No protected adaptive participant transport or per-case episode budget.

frozen_program.representation: The scorer accepts predictions and supplies fixed controls; a general frozen candidate fit/inference lifecycle is not delivered.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze candidate and fit recipe before query; preserve the complete keyed cohort and pre-outcome eligibility.
missing: Candidate lifecycle and authenticated native input/operator execution.
